description: PATCH /crm/businesses/:businessId/contacts/:contactId honours record visibility and business membership (R0-03 review ST-A high severity, ST-B should-fix). CrmService.updateContact applies the visibility clause GET detail applies (resolveCrmAccess + visibilityClause, the PR #190 semantics) in its access check and in its in-transaction read, so a contact the caller cannot see answers 404 byte-identical to an unknown id (timestamp and echoed path aside) with nothing written and no field of the row in the body; a visible contact the caller may not edit keeps its 403; a PATCH that changes ownerId is accepted only when the new owner holds a membership in the path business (the check reassignContacts applies, now shared as CrmService.assertNewOwnerIsMember), otherwise 400 with the bulk reassign message and nothing written ('' and unknown ids included), for HTTP and system-context callers; resending the current owner is not a change. Run from apps/server against a migrated local database and REDIS_URL: npx vitest run test/contacts-patch-visibility.integration.test.ts --reporter=json --outputFile=.proof/r0-13c-vitest.json, then node ../../scripts/proof-admission/evaluate.mjs --manifest ../../scripts/proof-admission/manifests/contacts-patch-visibility.json --report .proof/r0-13c-vitest.json. RED-BEFORE on the unmodified source at 13b7389a (tests-first commit b090af9a): 11 of 20 fail, exactly the NEGATIVE CONTROL cases (ST-A: PATCH {} and PATCH {jobTitle} 200, a bundled reassignment 403, a crm_reassign takeover 200, a my-book edit 200, crm_edit owned 403 instead of 404; ST-B: another tenant's user, an unknown id, '' and a bundled outsider 200, the system-context call resolves). allowAdditionalCases is false: a change that adds, renames or removes a case in that suite must make the same change here. Review repairs (pkt/R0-13c-CT-PATCH-VISIBILITY-repair on 45ede9cf, 26 cases): ST-R1, updateContact locks the contact row (SELECT id FROM contacts ... FOR UPDATE) in its transaction before the in-transaction read, so a PATCH that resends the owner it read while a reassignment commits is decided on the committed row (403 without crm_reassign, the answer the same request gets afterwards) and cannot silently undo the reassignment, skip the membership check or be audited as 'updated'; ST-R2, softDeleteContact and bulkDeleteContacts apply the same visibility clause: DELETE of a contact the caller cannot see answers 404 byte-identical to an unknown id (not the delete-scope 403; an ADMIN-role member, who gets 404 on GET, no longer soft-deletes another member's PRIVATE contact) and bulk delete skips a hidden id exactly like a missing one, while a visible contact outside crm_delete 'owned' keeps its 403. RED-BEFORE on 45ede9cf: exactly the 4 new NEGATIVE CONTROL cases fail (race 200 with owner_id restored to the departed owner, staff DELETE 403, ADMIN DELETE 200, bulk {deleted:1}); the 2 other new cases and the 20 earlier ones pass.
